title: SM-16.07 - What happens to existing surveys created by external users
intent: This article answers: SM-16.07 - What happens to existing surveys created by external users
short_answer: Existing surveys created by external users remain available during the transition period. In April 2027, they switch to read-only mode. In September 2027, external surveys are permanently closed and archived.
important_conditions: In read-only mode, surveys cannot be edited and no new responses can be collected.
Users should export their data before the read-only phase begins.
Surveys created by EU Institutions, Bodies, Offices or Agencies are not affected.
